bio: Enjoy Afternoon Tea with a perfect view out over 40 acres of beautiful parkland and the River Stour meandering through it. Ettington’s spectacular Norman chapel provides the perfect backdrop to savour culinary delights while soaking in some of the finest architecture.  Afternoon Tea at Ettington Park Hotel is served in the Great Drawing Room, with beautiful views over the gardens and grounds. In warmer months, you can also enjoy Afternoon Tea alfresco. This elegant yet relaxed setting makes it the perfect spot to unwind and indulge in this British tradition.  The Afternoon Tea menu features an array of savoury treats, scones and sweet pastries, along with a wide selection of loose-leaf teas. The talented pastry chefs prepare the scones and cakes freshly each day. The menu is refreshed regularly to celebrate various occasions throughout the year.  Ettington Park Hotel are also able to cater to a wide range of dietary requirements including gluten-free, vegan and have special children's Afternoon Tea options. Why not upgrade your traditional experience with a glass of Champagne or Prosecco for the height of luxury?
